name: StayGrid
description: Production-grade AI-powered hotel booking backend with dynamic pricing, concurrency control, and Stripe payment integration (Spring Boot, PostgreSQL)

paragraphs: A production-grade hotel booking backend built with Spring Boot, featuring dynamic pricing, real-time inventory management, and Stripe-powered payments.

StayGrid is a full-featured hotel booking REST API designed to mirror the core functionality of platforms like MakeMyTrip or Booking.com. It handles the complete lifecycle of a hotel reservation — from hotel onboarding and room inventory management, to guest booking, Stripe Checkout-based payments, and automated refunds on cancellation.
The system is built around two primary user roles:
features: Hotel Manager (HOTELMANAGER) — registers hotels, manages rooms, controls inventory availability, sets surge pricing, and views booking analytics.
Guest (GUEST) — searches hotels, browses room availability with real-time pricing, initiates bookings, adds guests, and completes payment via Stripe.
JWT Authentication with access token (10-minute expiry) + refresh token (6-month expiry via HttpOnly cookie)
Role-based access control — GUEST and HOTELMANAGER roles enforced at the security filter level
Dynamic pricing engine — Decorator pattern chain applying surge, occupancy, urgency, and holiday multipliers on top of a base price

whatItDoes.text: A production-grade hotel booking backend built with Spring Boot, featuring dynamic pricing, real-time inventory management, and Stripe-powered payments.

requirements.text: API key from env GEMINIAPIKEY; model from env GEMINIMODEL (default gemini-3.6-flash) — so model retirements never require a code change.
